title: Forced events on the map while the ecology levers are armed, against controls. CTRL, predators and small prey both open; as soon as the first wild wave lands, DFHack forces the event: a dwarven caravan (`force Caravan MOUNTAIN`), a migrant wave (`force Migrants`), or a megabeast (`force Megabeast`). Lever arms: 1,500 ticks later the predators are gathered to the prey and PREDATOR_OR_PREY written, then every 1,500 ticks (what the v5.6 ecology switch will do). Control arms: same forced event, no lever. Every 1,500 ticks: caravans, merchants, pack animals, citizens and megabeasts on the map and dead; predator combat reports; popups drained. 30,000 ticks after the force.
fork: v5.6 safety: do armed predators attack merchants, pack animals or migrants; does a megabeast disturb the wave machinery or pick up the relation; do the arrival popups halt the scheduler (F7). Forced, not waited for (user, 17 Sep).

predictions.model: the relation is pairwise between wild units only
predictions.expects: merchants, pack animals and migrants never appear in a predator's combat reports beyond the control's rate; megabeast arrival leaves arrivals and departures unchanged
lever arms show merchant, pack-animal or citizen combat and deaths the controls do not

predictions.model: a forced event is ignored or never reaches the map
predictions.expects: the event probe shows nothing new for the whole run in both arms; that event needs a different trigger

kill_criterion: a merchant, pack-animal or citizen death in a lever arm the control lacks is the positive; equal counts with the event present clears the lever for that event
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: caravan_control
pre: local site=df.world_site.find(df.global.plotinfo.site_id); local x0,x1=math.floor(site.global_min_x/16),math.floor(site.global_max_x/16); local y0,y1=math.floor(site.global_min_y/16),math.floor(site.global_max_y/16); local o,c=0,0; for _,p in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local r=p.population; if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal and r.feature_idx<0 and r.cave_id<0 and r.region_x>=x0-1 and r.region_x<=x1+1 and r.region_y>=y0-1 and r.region_y<=y1+1 and p.quantity_max<10000000 then local cr=df.creature_raw.find(p.race); local id=cr and cr.creature_id or ''; if (id=='PORCUPINE' or id=='ECHIDNA' or id=='BADGER' or id=='WOMBAT' or id=='BIRD_EMU' or id=='COUGAR' or id=='DINGO' or id=='WOLF') then p.quantity=30; p.flags.extinct=false; o=o+1 else p.quantity=0; p.flags.extinct=true; c=c+1 end end end; print(('opened %d entries at 30 (PORCUPINE ECHIDNA BADGER WOMBAT BIRD_EMU COUGAR DINGO WOLF); closed %d'):format(o,c))
on_arrival: local ok,err=pcall(dfhack.run_command,'force','Caravan','MOUNTAIN'); print('force Caravan MOUNTAIN ->', tostring(ok), tostring(err), 'caravans', #df.global.plotinfo.caravans, 'tick', df.global.cur_year_tick)

local c=df.global.plotinfo.caravans; local m,md,a,ad,cz,czd,mb,mbd=0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.all) do local dead=dfhack.units.isDead(u); if u.flags1.merchant then local isan=false; pcall(function() isan=dfhack.units.isAnimal(u) end); if isan then a=a+1; if dead then ad=ad+1 end else m=m+1; if dead then md=md+1 end end end; if dfhack.units.isCitizen(u) then cz=cz+1; if dead then czd=czd+1 end end; local cr=df.creature_raw.find(u.race); local cs=cr and cr.caste[u.caste]; if cs and (cs.flags.MEGABEAST or cs.flags.SEMIMEGABEAST) then mb=mb+1; if dead then mbd=mbd+1 end end end; local ents=''; for _,cv in ipairs(c) do local e=df.historical_entity.find(cv.entity); ents=ents..' '..(e and e.entity_raw.code or '?')..':'..tostring(cv.time_remaining) end; print(('events: caravans=%d [%s] merchants=%d dead=%d animals=%d dead=%d citizens=%d dead=%d megabeasts=%d dead=%d season=%d tick=%d'):format(#c, ents, m, md, a, ad, cz, czd, mb, mbd, df.global.cur_season, df.global.cur_year_tick))
